title: Hearty Dutch Bean Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful stew made with tender beans and rich dutch flavors.

ingredients.name: Dutch sausage, sliced
ingredients.notes: look for a vegetarian alternative if needed

ingredients.name: Braised red wine
ingredients.notes: or beef broth for a different flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove sausage from pot and set aside. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add braised red wine, scraping up browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add beans, sausage, flaky sea salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until flavors have melded together and the stew has thickened, about 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
